description: Every closed arithmetic term has, in every model of \(Q\), the numeral value of its value in standard arithmetic.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.closed_term_evaluation.{u} (M : Type u)
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.Q]
  (t : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Term Empty) :
  FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize Empty.elim t =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.closedTermValue t)
